Card Q&A.a:
BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect places all of your Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait into your security stack. In such cases, this card's [All Turns] effect prevents this Digimon from being deleted, but if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward, you can place all of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon that were affected by the deletion effect into your security stack.

Card Q&A.q: I have this card and BT19-053 [QueenBeemon] in the battle area. My opponent uses BT5-110 [All Delete] and I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon would leave the battle area at the same time, and this Digimon is prevented from leaving. What happens if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward?

Effect: {Security} [Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait gain ＜Blocker＞.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, by flipping your top face-up security card face down, it doesn't leave.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, by flipping your top face-up security card face down, 1 of those Digimon doesn't leave.
